observations: Black PS4 Slim-shaped console with PlayStation logo visible, centered on a woven mat surface.
Two black DualShock-style controllers lie to the left of the console.
A bundle of loose cables (likely power and HDMI/USB) sits coiled near the controllers.
One game case is visible to the right, showing a player in a blue kit; partial text resembles 'FIFA 2_' but the exact number is obscured by the photo's watermark.
A watermark reading 'CHI BROS MUSICALS POSTED ON ...' overlays the image, indicating it may be a reused or stock listing photo.
No other game cases (Ghost of Tsushima, Spider-Man, or a second FIFA title) are visible in this single photo.
No power-on, screen, or serial/label shot is provided.

risks.proof: A video clip showing the console powering on to the PS4 home screen and reading a disc.

risks.risk: Claimed games (Ghost of Tsushima, Spider-Man, extra FIFA titles) may not actually be included.
risks.proof: A photo showing all game cases laid out together with readable titles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console + 2 controllers + 1 unverified disc only, extra games treated as not included

risks.risk: Controllers may have analog drift, worn buttons, or battery issues.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of each controller in use (analog stick movement, button response).

risks.risk: Listing photo bears a watermark suggesting reuse from another seller's post, raising doubt about whether this is the actual unit for sale.
risks.proof: A fresh, unwatermarked photo of the actual unit with a handwritten note or timestamp.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and loading a game from disc.
Clear photo of all game cases together, with titles readable.
Close-up photos of both controllers (analog sticks, buttons, charging port).
A fresh photo of the unit with today's date or a handwritten note to confirm it's the actual item.
response.reason: The photo confirms a PS4 Slim-type console with two controllers and one unreadable disc, but 'working' status and most claimed games are unverified, and the FIFA 26 claim is factually contradicted; only one comparable in the list matches a PS4 at all, so it anchors both ends of the worst-case range.
